items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I don't think he's on any picture, not even the one with the overcoats. That has Dan Minor.

ctx.x: He's in while you're still in Texas? I thought you didn't get him until you came back down into Texas again? He's only on that one picture--no, I don't think he's in any of the pictures.
I don't think he's on any picture, not even the one with the overcoats. That has Dan Minor.
I have a picture of Hilliard, because I got a picture of Hilliard with Stuff's band up in Buffalo, he was playing in the trumpet section. He played trumpet and alto.
